newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron unit's KL listing underwritten.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron unit's KL listing underwritten.

text.p: Electronics group Goldtron Ltd said on Tuesday the listing of its Malaysian unit, Measurex Corporation Berhad (MCB), on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange would be fully underwritten.
Goldtron said in a statement that DCB Sakura Merchant Bankers Berhad would be the managing underwriter, with Rashid Hussain Securities Sdn Bhd and Kestrel Securities Sdn Bhd as underwriters.
Goldtron said it would realise an extraordinary profit of about Singapore $28.97 million from the sale of 11.56 million MCB shares at an issue price of Ringgit 7.00 per share.
Goldtron said its interest in MCB would be diluted from 80 percent to 40 percent after the listing.
